note: Floor height (m) at the CENTRE of 0.5 m cells (resampled from the lab's 0.25 m raster: model.floorY); null = no floor (outside the rooms, more than 0.2 m under the walls, the void apron is not listed). index = j * nx + i, x = x0 + (i + 0.5) * cell, z = z0 + (j + 0.5) * cell. Exact function: floorY(x, z) of env/act1/interior.js compile() (levels, sloping floors, stairs, ramps, water).
